id.description:
Unique identifier for this balance issued by Cash App.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `256`

customer_id.description:
ID of the customer associated with this balance.

Min length: `1`
Max length: `128`

amount.description: The balance amount, in the lowest denomination of the currency (for example, cents for USD).

created_at.description: When this balance was created, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

updated_at.description: When this balance was last updated, in [RFC 3339](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339) format (UTC).

Currency.description:
Indicates the country associated with an entity. Values are from the [ISO-4217 Alpha-3](https://www.iso.org/iso-4217-currency-codes.html) specification.

Current values:

- `USD`: United States Dollar
